# Shift in Collision Volume Before/After COVID
The COVID-19 pandemic and quarantine seem to have had a lasting effect on the number of traffic collisions occurring in LA. We'll explore in later analysis how this is driven by changes in car commuter volume as more workers began to work from home
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    mutate(OccurredDateRounded = floor_date(OccurredDate, unit='weeks')) %>%
    group_by(OccurredDateRounded, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(Collisions = n(),
              NumDays = n_distinct(OccurredDate)) %>%
    filter(NumDays == 7) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=OccurredDateRounded, y=Collisions, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(x='Week of Collision Occurence', y='Number of Collisions', color='') +
    ggtitle('Influence of COVID Lockdown on Number of Collisions per Week')
)
```
## By area
```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    mutate(OccurredDateRounded = floor_date(OccurredDate, unit='months')) %>%
    group_by(OccurredDateRounded, COVIDPeriod, AreaName) %>%
    summarise(Collisions = n(),
              NumDays = n_distinct(OccurredDate)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=OccurredDateRounded, y=Collisions, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_line() +
    facet_wrap(~AreaName) +
    labs(x='Month of Collision Occurrence', y='Number of Collisions', color='') +
    ggtitle('Influence of COVID Lockdown on Number of Collisions by AreaName')
)
```


# OccurredTime - Time of Day of Collision
## Pre-COVID vs Post-COVID
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>%
    filter(OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
    group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(OccurredTime = floor(OccurredTime/100)*100, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(CollisionProportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=OccurredTime, y=CollisionProportion, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_line() + ylim(0, NA) +
    labs(x='Time of Collision Occurrence', y='Distribution of Collisions', color='') +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collision Occurrence Times')
)
```
## By volume instead of distribution
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>%
    filter(OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
    group_by(OccurredTime = floor(OccurredTime/100)*100, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(Collisions = n()) %>%

    geom_line() + ylim(0, NA) +
    labs(x='Time of Collision Occurrence', y='Number of Collisions', color='') +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collision Occurrence Times')
)
```

# Demographic Data
## Age
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>%
    filter(OccurredYear >= 2016) %>%
    group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(VictimAge = floor(VictimAge/5)*5, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(CollisionProportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=VictimAge, y=CollisionProportion, color=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_line() + ylim(0, NA) +
    labs(x='Victim Age', y='Distribution of Collisions', color='') +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collision Victim Age')
)
```


## Sex
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    filter(OccurredYear > 2016) %>%
    mutate(VictimSex = case_when(
      VictimSex %in% c('M', 'F') ~ VictimSex,
      TRUE ~ 'Other or Unknown'
    )) %>%
    group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions=n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(VictimSex, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(CollisionProportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=VictimSex, y=CollisionProportion, fill=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge') +
    labs(x='Collision Victim Sex', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill='') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collision Victim Sex')
)
```

## Race and Ethnicity
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    filter(OccurredYear > 2016) %>%
    group_by(COVIDPeriod) %>% mutate(TotalCollisions=n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(VictimEthnicity, COVIDPeriod) %>%
    summarise(CollisionProportion = n()/first(TotalCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=VictimEthnicity, y=CollisionProportion, fill=COVIDPeriod)) +
    geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge') +
    labs(x='Collision Victim Race/Ethnicity', y='Proportion of Collisions', fill='') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Distribution of Collision Victim Race/Ethnicity')
)
```

## Race/Ethnicity in Conjuction with Sex
```{r}
print(
  collisions_cleaned %>% 
    filter(OccurredYear > 2016, OccurredYear != 2020) %>%
    mutate(VictimSex = case_when(VictimSex %in% c('M', 'F') ~ VictimSex, 
                                 TRUE ~ 'Other or Unknown'),
           PreCOVIDCollision = COVIDPeriod == 'Pre-COVID',
           PostCOVIDCollision = COVIDPeriod == 'Post-COVID') %>%
    group_by(1) %>% mutate(TotalPreCOVIDCollisions = sum(PreCOVIDCollision, na.rm=TRUE),
                           TotalPostCOVIDCollisions = sum(PostCOVIDCollision, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% group_by(VictimSex, VictimEthnicity) %>%
    summarise(
      ChangeInProportion = sum(PostCOVIDCollision, na.rm=TRUE)/first(TotalPostCOVIDCollisions) -
        sum(PreCOVIDCollision, na.rm=TRUE)/first(TotalPreCOVIDCollisions)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=VictimEthnicity, y=ChangeInProportion, fill=VictimSex)) +
    geom_bar(stat='identity', position='dodge') +
    labs(x='Collision Victim Race/Ethnicity', y='Change in Proportion of Collisions', fill='Victim Sex') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
    ggtitle('Change in Collision Victim Race/Ethnicity and Sex After COVID')
)
```

# By Location
## Scatterplot of Latitude, Longitude, 
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
for (year in c(2011:2024)) {
  print(
    collisions_by_coordinates_and_year %>%
      arrange(TotalCollisions) %>% 
      filter(OccurredYear == local(year),
             between(Latitude, 33.6, 34.4),
             between(Longitude, -118.75, -118.125)
             ) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, color=TotalCollisions)) +
      geom_point(size=2.5) +
      ggtitle(paste0('Total Collisions by Coordinates in ', year, sep=''))
  )
}
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
print(
  collisions_by_coordinates_and_year %>%
    arrange(TotalCollisions) %>% 
    filter(between(OccurredYear, 2016, 2024),
           OccurredYear != 2020,
           between(Latitude, 33.6, 34.4),
            between(Longitude, -118.75, -118.125)
           ) %>%
    mutate(COVIDPeriod = ifelse(
      OccurredYear < 2020, 'Pre-COVID', 'Post-COVID') %>%
        factor(levels=c('Pre-COVID', 'Post-COVID'))) %>%
    group_by(COVIDPeriod, Longitude, Latitude) %>%
    summarise(TotalCollisions = sum(TotalCollisions, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, color=TotalCollisions)) +
    geom_point(size=2.5) + facet_wrap(~COVIDPeriod) + labs(color='Total Collisions') +
    ggtitle(paste0('Total Collisions by Coordinates, Pre- vs Post-COVID', sep=''))
)


```
